title: Before the Distance: The Story of John & Erin
description: An official five-song narrative story published by Ryan and Cassidy O'Connell of The Stardust Engine across Progress Street (2004) and Lost Sounds (2007). At Commonwealth Polytechnic Institute (CPI) in Blacksburg, Virginia, fraternal twins John and Erin navigate the steep limestone hills of campus in their power wheelchairs. When an accidental track skip from 'Seconds Into Forever' to 'Thunder in the Rain' at a campus speed-dating event places John across the table from a woman he doesn't realize will become his abuser, it takes Erin's split-second executive decision at the CPI Transit Center ('Before the Distance') to pull her brother onto the Blue Ridge Transit bus before the steel doors close—forging a sibling sanctuary ('Sanctuary in the Storm') that comes full circle when John protects Erin in 'Not Her'.

title: Upon This Winter's Night: The Story of Julian Rowlands
description: The complete origin narrative behind The Arctic Symphony Project (originally formed as The Winter Palace) and their 3-disc symphonic rock opera 'Tales from the Solstice'. When fourteen-year-old Julian Thomas Rowlands ('Julep')—who is non-verbal, autistic, and uses a manual wheelchair—is abducted from Ewell, Virginia on December 11, 1996 by his estranged father, his fierce twin siblings Gabriel and Gwendolyn Rowlands and his twin anchors Maria and Clara Harrison turn their living room into a war room and broadcast a symphonic rock rescue beacon across the Appalachian radio towers. Spanning from Julian's 1996 abduction and Ohio rescue, the forging of the vaulted Trilingual 'Family Mix' in Cymraeg, Québécois French, and English, and the family's 1998 return to Anglesey, Wales, to their 2007 meeting in Williamsburg with Samantha, Jyn, and Matthew—whose cross-country abduction from Norfolk to Seattle was survived using Julian's song as his sonic armor.

title: Runebreaker: The Dream Kingdom
description: For four hundred and four years of the Era of the Crystal, the inhabitants of the Dream Kingdom whispered of an ancient legend: that the Sundered Crystal—one half crimson, one half sapphire—would one day return to reunite the fractured code of their world. Over the centuries, as the tyrannical Grand Wizard seized the Great Directory and no trace of the two halves was ever found, the people came to believe the Crystal was nothing more than a myth. Then, on a quiet Friday night in October 1992, eighteen-year-old fraternal twins Ocea and Tay are pulled through the glass of their living room CRT television—each carrying half of the painted clay summer-camp medallion they made together in the real world. Set to the 23-track Runebreaker (Original Soundtrack) by Mana Canvas, this chronicle follows Ocea's barefoot quest in her t-shirt and jeans to rescue her older twin brother and usher in the Era of the Restored Realm.
